about_the_game:
Alchemortis is a dark fantasy roguelite autobattler built on grid-based inventory management. Battles are determined by the placement of cards, with card positioning shaping attack patterns, defenses, and synergies.

Each run is driven by alchemy, with cards alchemized into new forms that transform strategies and builds during a run.

Set in a world of alchemy, necromancy, and medieval science, the game combines tactical depth with roguelite replayability in a dark fantasy setting.

Features

  • Grid-based inventory strategy – Card placement determines attack patterns, defenses, and synergies.

  • Alchemy system – Alchemize cards into new forms, unlocking new strategies and evolving builds.

  • Varied arsenal – From necromantic minions to weapons and relics, cards form a diverse toolkit for grid-based strategy.

  • Autobattler combat – Strategy is decided before the fight, then carried out on its own.

  • Roguelite replayability – Experiment with countless combinations and discover new builds each run.

  • Dark fantasy setting – A world shaped by alchemy, necromancy, and medieval science.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz) or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 / Apple GPU)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
